question: Birdie, eagle and albatross are all terms used in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**golf.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The modern game of golf originated in** Scotland.**
 
• Birdie, eagle and albatross are all terms used in **golf.**__
 
• Golf is played in **course.**
 
• A golf course consists of either 9 or 18 holes.
 
• **Par** in golf refers to the number of strokes a golfer is expected to need to complete the play of one hole on a golf course.
 
• **Brible **is a score of one-under-par on a hole.
 
• **Eagle** is the score of two under par.
 
• **Albatros** is the score of three under par (very rare).
 
• Important terms associated with** golf** are:
 __
 
• Ace.
 
• Handicap.
 
• Putt.
 
• Drive.
 
• Duff.
 
• Mulligan.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Important terms associated with **football** are:

• Goal.
 
• Head.

• Hattrick.
